title: Survivor Support & Protection
summary: Every survivor deserves safety, dignity, and someone who listens.
description: Dafara stands alongside survivors of sexual violence, supporting care, emotional wellbeing, and recovery. Being heard and treated with respect is central to this work.

title: Children’s Care & Opportunity
summary: Care, belonging, and opportunities for children facing hardship.
description: This program focuses on orphaned children, children living on the streets, and families facing severe hardship. Food, clothing, shelter, and access to learning can help children grow with dignity and a sense of belonging.

title: Clean Water & Access
summary: Safe water for everyday life and healthier communities.
description: Clean water is essential for drinking, cooking, and everyday wellbeing. This program focuses on access to safe water and the needs of communities facing water shortages.

title: Environmental Protection
summary: Caring for the natural resources that sustain our communities.
description: Protecting the environment supports the people who depend on it. This program focuses on caring for natural resources and encouraging communities to protect the places they call home.

title: Education & Entrepreneurship
summary: Learning, practical skills, and pathways to independence.
description: Poverty can put education out of reach. Dafara supports access to learning and educational resources, while education and entrepreneurship offer pathways toward more independent futures.

title: Health & Wellbeing
summary: Dignity and support for people facing illness and disability.
description: Dafara supports people facing cancer, chronic illness, and disability. Children with autism and their families are an important part of this work, with attention to education, care, and inclusion.
